views.label: Submit and poll
views.note: A client submits Compute and polls GetOperation while the row lives in workitems_active.

views.label: Worker loop
views.note: The worker claims one row, renews the lease, runs the task, then releases it.

views.label: Maintenance
views.note: In-process cron work and storage notifications retire rows nobody will finish.

cards.title: Queue
items: One table pair: workitems_active drains into workitems_inactive
A claim is a single UPDATE guarded by FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Rows are ordered by created_at and filtered by expires_at and worker version

cards.title: Worker contract
items: ClaimWorkItem returns input plus metadata, or nothing when the queue is empty
RefreshClaim extends the 7s lease every 5s while Task.Run executes
Success and error both release the row into workitems_inactive

cards.title: Recovery
items: A lapsed claim is re-claimable while claimed_count stays under MAX_CLAIM_RETRIES
Background tasks retire expired and exhausted rows on a fixed interval
Permanent storage deletes remove the work items that referenced the object
